Name: Health Bars
Author: alvesgu
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Death comes unexpectedly when you're low on HP and don't realize it. This mod adds a health bar above you, so you'll have a better chance to notice you gotta heal. Applies to player characters and visible monsters. Bars update in real time and are fully customizable: style, color, size, opacity, and border. Do it through an in-game menu powered by Generic Mod Config Menu (gamepads only have cursor support). No config file editing is required, but it's available.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] if you haven't already;[/*]
[*]Optionally install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for the in-game settings UI;[/*]
[*]Download the latest release and unzip it;[/*]
[*]Place the HealthBars folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods/ folder;[/*]
[*]Launch the game through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Main features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Health bar above the player, centered over their head and updating in real time;[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Health bars above every visible monster, disappearing when they die or leave the screen;[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Three bar styles: Flat, Rounded (pill/capsule), and Striped;[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Fill color modes: Gradient (shifts through three stops as health changes), Custom (pick any RGB color), or three quick presets;[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Custom color pickers with palette swatches and R/G/B sliders for fill, gradient stops, and border;[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Adjustable width, height, vertical/horizontal position, border thickness, and opacity;[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Live preview panel in the config menu, see every change before saving with the current season background;[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Works in split-screen co-op (not tested online yet).[/color][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional — without it the mod still works; edit config.json manually to change settings)[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Shout outs[/size][/b]
Monster health bar concept inspired by [url=https://github.com/mk-gg/hp-bars]hp-bars[/url] by mk-gg, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/193]Enemy Health Bars (SMAPI)[/url] by OrSpeeder, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8329]Mini Bars[/url] by Coldopa. Thanks to Pathoschild for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and spacechase0 for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. Thanks to ConcernedApe for creating this game and inspiring me to vibe code this mod.
